headline: Arhan canli gains 9.17 to reach 30th on ARC-2

sections.text: Arhan canli gained 9.17 to reach 52.50, moving from 42nd to 30th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move places Arhan among the board’s top 30 as the gold places remain the next standings line to watch.
